podcast.title: Italian Hardcore Scene
podcast.body: Wretched was a band that emerged from Italy's own distinct hardcore punk scene. "The Italians had their own scene with bands like Raw Power and Wretched."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Part of Italian Hardcore Scene
podcast.body: Wretched is mentioned as a key band in Italy's own hardcore scene, alongside Raw Power, demonstrating the international spread of the genre. "The Italians had their own scene with bands like Raw Power and Wretched."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Initial CD Releases and Liner Notes (1983)
xref.body: When CDs first launched in 1983, initial releases, including some of The Beatles' albums, often came with "wretched" and uninspired liner note booklets. These early CD packages frequently featured minimal content, sometimes just a small piece of glossy paper with one side blank, falling short of the detailed liner notes seen on vinyl LPs. "Some of the first Beatles albums released on CD came this way."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
